attributes.name: Godclaw Gauntlets
attributes.powers:
On your combat check, if you did not play a weapon, recharge this card to add 1d6+2 and the Magic and Slashing traits; if this card has the Corrupted trait, discard 2 cards.

Display this card next to your location. While displayed, when a character at this location encounters a monster, add 2d4 and the Fire trait to her combat checks. At the end of your turn, bury this card.
